method: Orthographic all-triangle projected coverage; pixel is background only if no mesh triangle covers its ray. Fixed, order-derived masks. Flat opaque geometry and constant background rendered to PNG; background RGB counted within the unchanged masks. No source texture/alpha reliance.

supportDatum.note: All three reported; robust estimates are descriptive and do not replace the global minimum.

front_large.maskDefinition: fixed order dimensions, centered at facade datum; straight jambs and semicircular crown, no fitted/shrunk mask

left_narrow.maskDefinition: fixed order dimensions, centered at facade datum; straight jambs and semicircular crown, no fitted/shrunk mask

limits: Flat-color orthographic image test backed by all-triangle ray coverage; source materials are not used. Through-view opposite walls and intrados are included as occlusion. A low score proves blocked orthographic rays inside the fixed mask, but does not identify the blocking surface.
